scope: Motion coordination, native-window mocks, frame geometry, visual review and selected feature regressions; not an exhaustive certification of every historical test.
environment: Linux Chromium with simulated native viewport and Windows APIs

motionCoordination.environment: Linux Chromium; native viewport and IPC simulated
checks: Same-state requests do not restart animation or resize the host
45ms double-click reverses from the currently displayed frame
Open/close and tab morphs stay centered and do not attach a moving native webview
20/75/160ms tab storms cannot commit a stale shrink
Interrupted collapse and tab navigation survive delayed IPC
Tray reveal runs together with expansion, without a second fade or flash
Animations off and system reduced-motion use the same correct final geometry

testHarnessUpdates: Weather regression now waits for the native service to attach after geometry settles.
Widget editor regression selects its existing Dashboard settings category before accessing controls.
Browser tests using CHROMIUM_PATH were rerun with the installed Chromium path.
limitations: Real Windows/Electron window manager, GPU and display scaling require on-device testing.
Live third-party accounts and DRM playback were not tested.
No Windows EXE is included; this is the complete source archive.
